title: Disaster Assistance Deadlines Alignment Act
official_summary:
Disaster Assistance Deadlines Alignment Act

This act modifies the deadline for applying for disaster unemployment assistance.

Specifically, the act matches the deadline for an individual seeking unemployment assistance for a major disaster under the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act to the application deadline for individuals and households seeking other assistance under that act.

The act authorizes an extension of that deadline if the individual (1) has good cause for the late submission, and (2) submits the application during the period when disaster assistance is being provided.

summary.headline: Law gives people who lose work in a major disaster the same deadline to apply for unemployment help as other disaster aid.
summary.what_it_does: This law changes the deadline to apply for disaster unemployment assistance after a major disaster. The new deadline matches the deadline for individuals and households applying for other federal disaster aid under the Stafford Act. People can get extra time if they have a good reason for applying late and they apply while disaster aid is still being given out.

who_it_affects.group: Workers and self-employed people who lose jobs or income because of a federally declared major disaster
who_it_affects.how: Their deadline to apply for disaster unemployment assistance now matches the deadline for other individual disaster aid, and they may get more time if they have a good reason for applying late.

who_it_affects.group: Disaster survivors applying for federal aid for individuals and households
who_it_affects.how: They face one matching deadline for unemployment help and other individual disaster aid instead of separate deadlines.

who_it_affects.group: State agencies and federal officials who run disaster unemployment programs
who_it_affects.how: They must use the new matching deadline and may accept late applications with good cause during the aid period.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted March 18, 2024; the summary does not state a separate start date.
